_comment: bb-buck P3 parts list. Build qty 5, JLC PCBA single-sided (all SMT top; J1/J2 THT). Every LCSC code/stock/price verified live via parts_search.py at selection time (2026-08-15), not carried from research-phase memory. One entry per DISTINCT part; 'refs' lists every refdes it covers. See part-sourcer SUMMARY/OPEN for the four P2-condition findings (thermal recompute, light-load ripple, L/C window, inductor Isat) and three deviations from architecture/blocks.md (C1 220nF not 100nF, output-bank case 1210 not 1206, new C7 VCC bypass, J1/J2 250V not >=300V). P4 FIX PASS 2026-08-15 (adversarial review + SPICE bench, all three owner-approved): output bank 2->4 x 22uF (E1, add C8/C9), input bulk 2->3 x 10uF (W1, add C10), FB divider recentred 100k/24.9k -> 102k/25.5k for an exact 4.000 ratio and 5.000V nominal (A3) - stock/price for the two new resistor lines re-verified live at fix time.

parts.value: LMR33630A - 36V-class synchronous buck, 400kHz fixed, adjustable FB, peak-current-mode, exposed-pad SOIC-8
parts.role: The block under study (D1-D4). Single-source at this exact 400kHz DDA variant - see OPEN for why the same-package B/C frequency siblings are not safe drop-ins.
Power inductor. Isat 8A clears the D11 floor (1.3x part I_SC-max = 6.6A) with 21% margin; -40 to 125C confirmed family-wide in the vendor catalog (p1 Environmental Data).
VIN-pin HF bypass. Datasheet 9.2.2.6 specifies 220nF 50V X7R for this exact function, not the generic 100nF blocks.md carries - see SUMMARY.

Input bulk bank (hot-loop group with C1, C6). 3x10uF nameplate, raised from 2x at the P4 fix pass (W1): 9.2.2.6 asks for a 10uF MINIMUM and 9.1 p19 defines the datasheet's cap values as EFFECTIVE, not nameplate - 2x10uF/50V/1210 is 10-12uF effective at 30V bias and 8.5-10.5uF once tolerance and the 85-90C board temperature stack, i.e. under the minimum in the worst corner. Bias-derating curve for this exact MPN still not independently pulled - see OPEN.
BOOT-SW bootstrap cap, datasheet-required (9.2.2.7). Only Basic part in this list.
VCC-GND internal-LDO bypass, datasheet-mandatory (9.2.2.8: 'requires a 1uF 16V ceramic ... for proper operation'). NEW - absent from blocks.md's diagram; added here per spawn part list - see SUMMARY.

Output bank, 4x22uF - raised from 2x at the P4 fix pass (E1). Sec 9.2 p19 says the internal compensation is optimized for a range of external L and C_OUT, and that range is quantified only in Table 9-2 p20: this board matches the 400kHz/5V row on every entry except L and C_OUT, and that row (like every 400kHz row) specifies 4x22uF rated; TI's own DDA characterization BOM (Table 9-3 p31) used 4x22uF. With fixed internal Type-II compensation fc scales as 1/C_OUT, so 2x pushes crossover toward fSW/2=200kHz on an all-ceramic bank with no ESR phase boost. Case is 1210, not blocks.md's 1206 - no 22uF/25V/X7R part is stocked in 1206 at any usable stock level; 1210 matches the datasheet's own reference-design case (9.2.2.5, '4x22uF 16V 1210'). See SUMMARY.

FB divider top resistor (+5V side). 102k, not 100k, since the P4 fix pass (A3 setpoint): with R2=25.5k the ratio is an exact 4.000, so Vout = 1.000*(1+4.000) = 5.000V nominal instead of 5.016V. Sec 7.7's light-load spec (-1.5/+2.5% for IOUT 0A to max, vs -1.5/+1.5% above 1A) stacks a +1.0% adder on the 0A corner the A3 window must contain; recentring moves the stacked worst case from 5.161V (outside the 5.15V ceiling) to ~5.144V (inside). Still the datasheet's 100k-class top recommendation (9.2.2.3) and two decades under the 1M threshold that would demand a CFF - the CFF position stays open. Same YAGEO RT0603BRD 0.1%/25ppm family as before, so TCR tracking with R2 is preserved.

FB divider bottom resistor (GND side). 25.5k, not 24.9k, since the P4 fix pass (A3 setpoint) - see R1. Same YAGEO RT0603BRD 0.1%/25ppm family as R1 for TCR tracking (D6). With R1 gives Vout 5.000V nominal, centred in 4.85-5.15V; divider draws 39uA.
J1 (input, left edge) and J2 (output, bottom edge), same part for BOM consolidation per blocks.md. 24A clears >=10A with 2.4x margin; 250V is one catalog tier under the >=300V ask - see SUMMARY.

refdes_notes.J1: THT screw terminal - hand-solder AFTER reflow. GND pin is flooded SOLID into the B.Cu pour (no thermal relief, deliberate - see fab/README-fab-notes.md); use a 60-80 W iron or preheat.
refdes_notes.J2: THT screw terminal - hand-solder AFTER reflow. Same solid-flood GND pin as J1; same iron/preheat note.
